g.text: Historical v6b: successes separated by physical task
Dots: training seeds 31 / 41 / 51; diamond: non-learning feedback. Numbers are successes / 16. Same cases are paired, not independent replicates.
Previously inspected historical tests; no tuning or final-test claim for the new pilot. Synthetic JAKA PhysX tasks, not field or an official benchmark.
